name: Bollinger price raw
description: 000985.XSHG daily close for later Bollinger-band calculation. No band or signal is calculated.
notes: Bollinger parameters are not applied in this stage.

name: Margin buy stock raw
description: Stock-level buy_on_margin_value returned by rqdatac.get_securities_margin. File may contain only stocks with margin records.
notes: Non-margin sample returned None in follow-up probe; missing stock-date records should be treated as no margin record, not as confirmed zero unless manually approved.

name: A-share daily raw
description: Stock-level A-share close, prev_close, and amount for later advance/decline amount calculations.
notes: Flat stocks are included in total_amount but not up_amount/down_amount. Newly listed stocks with missing prev_close are included in total_amount if amount is available, but not up/down. ST stocks are not filtered. Suspended rows are kept as returned by rqdatac; missing amount is ignored by pandas sum.

name: Advance decline amount daily
description: Prepared daily aggregate table with up_amount, down_amount and total_amount. This is an intermediate data table, not a timing signal.

fields.up_amount: sum of amount where close > prev_close
fields.down_amount: sum of amount where close < prev_close
fields.total_amount: sum of amount across returned stock rows

notes: Flat stocks are included in total_amount but not up_amount/down_amount. Newly listed stocks with missing prev_close are included in total_amount if amount is available, but not up/down. ST stocks are not filtered. Suspended rows are kept as returned by rqdatac; missing amount is ignored by pandas sum.

name: 50ETF option contract raw
description: Contract-level 50ETF option volume, amount and open interest.
notes: Only 510050.XSHG options are included for PCR.

name: 50ETF option PCR daily
description: Daily aggregated put/call volume, amount, and open interest ratios for 50ETF options.
notes: PCR ratios are prepared data series, not final timing signals.

name: Option IV contract raw
description: Contract-level option IV for 50ETF, 300ETF and 500ETF option candidates, plus underlying ETF close as underlying_price.
notes: underlying_price is not returned by options.get_greeks; it is joined from the underlying ETF close.

name: Option IV selected daily
description: Nearest-month and nearest-moneyness selected contracts for 105/95, 110/90 and 120/80 pairs.
notes: Nearest-neighbor selection is implemented. Interpolation is saved in the ratio table.

name: Option IV ratio daily
description: Prepared IV high/low ratio table using nearest-neighbor and interpolation versions.
notes: This is a prepared data ratio, not a final timing signal.

name: Futures member rank raw
description: Top-20 member rank raw data for IF and extension underlyings IH/IC when available.
notes: rqdatac.futures.get_member_rank returns a generic column named volume. This script calls rank_by='long' and rank_by='short' and renames returned volume to long_position/short_position. This field meaning still needs manual confirmation against CFFEX wording.

name: Futures member long short daily
description: Daily top-20 long and short member position sums and long/short ratio for IF/IH/IC.
notes: rqdatac.futures.get_member_rank returns a generic column named volume. This script calls rank_by='long' and rank_by='short' and renames returned volume to long_position/short_position. This field meaning still needs manual confirmation against CFFEX wording.

name: ERP raw
description: 000985.XSHG PE_TTM and China treasury 10Y yield aligned by date; no ERP signal is calculated.
notes: 000985.XSHG is used as the Wind All-A proxy confirmed by the user request.

name: Margin buy market raw
description: Market-level buy_on_margin_value for XSHE and XSHG returned directly by rqdatac.get_securities_margin.
notes: This version follows the report requirement more closely than stock-level aggregation.

name: Margin buy total
description: Daily all-market margin buying value aggregated from the two market-level rows XSHE and XSHG.
notes: Downloaded directly at market level from RiceQuant, then summed across the two exchanges.
